reuseSearch: Checked original integral Hecke transversals, exact subgroup conjugation, native finite coset trace and binary coefficient action before adapting the archived product-correspondence proof.
routeAdjustment: Use existing upper-coset representatives at level Q*p to obtain the required lower-subgroup transversal, replacing the external modular-arithmetic factorization. Prove the degree-one representative correction directly from native cocycle identities. Keep native H1 and use the existing prescribed-character and injective tensor-reduction consumers. Preserve Apache-2.0 attribution and the archived LICENSE/NOTICE.
discharged: All actual full good-prime binary H1 Hecke operators commute over every coefficient ring and in every binary degree. The proof constructs the exact product-coset bijection from existing integral transversals, composes the literal subgroup conjugations and coefficient maps, and proves the degree-one representative corrections are actual native coboundaries. This removes the final commutativity premise from the original primitive residual eigensystem consumer. For every original primitive form of weight at least two and every prescribed rational prime, a genuine local coefficient field and nonzero residual native H1 eigenclass realize all original good-prime Fourier reductions. No assumed integral span, character realization, reduction injection, commutativity or residual eigenclass remains.
remaining: Finite-characteristic weight/level reduction and geometric residual Galois association remain to be proved. These residual cohomological results do not yet supply an all-weight adic system, purity, crystallinity, Sato-Tate or higher symmetric-power automorphy. Acceptance remains 16/20; DUB-17--20 are open.
